style_line: Style: 1990s Japanese OVA hand-painted cel look: thick brush-like black ink outlines, airbrushed cel highlights on the shell and hat, rich deep colors, strong rim lighting, a little gritty and cinematic. Full body, centered, standing upright, facing slightly to the right, holding a magnifying glass in one flipper, no text, no letters, no logos. PNG with a fully transparent background (alpha channel), square 1024x1024, subject fills about 80% of the canvas.

personas.P1_macho: An anthropomorphic sea turtle detective who is extremely muscular: huge bulging biceps and chest, thick neck, the orange trench coat sleeves rolled up to show massive arms, the coat straining at the shoulders, a brown deerstalker hat, a confident grin with a raised eyebrow, flexing slightly.
personas.P2_intellectual: An anthropomorphic sea turtle detective who is a scholarly intellectual: round wire-rim glasses, a neat green bow tie under an orange trench coat, a thick book tucked under one arm, a brown deerstalker hat, a calm knowing smile, slender refined build.
personas.P3_veteran: An anthropomorphic sea turtle detective who is a wise old veteran: bushy white eyebrows and a white walrus mustache, a wooden walking cane in the other flipper, a slightly worn orange trench coat and a brown deerstalker hat, a gentle dignified smile, slightly hunched with dignity.
personas.P4_scruffy: An anthropomorphic sea turtle detective who is a scruffy, sleepy-looking genius (Columbo-like): rumpled wrinkled orange trench coat, brown deerstalker hat pushed back, half-closed tired eyes with a sly smile, a paper coffee cup in the other flipper, stubble-like shading on the chin, casual slouching posture.
personas.P5_gentleman: An anthropomorphic sea turtle detective who is a refined British gentleman: a gold monocle on one eye, a small top-hat-like deerstalker hybrid hat in brown tweed, a cravat, a pocket watch chain across a tweed vest under an orange trench coat, an elegant walking cane in the other flipper, chin slightly raised, poised and dignified smile.
personas.P6_gourmet: An anthropomorphic sea turtle detective who is a plump gourmet: round chubby body, a bib napkin tucked into the collar of the orange trench coat, holding a steaming bowl of soup in the other flipper with a spoon, brown deerstalker hat, blissful satisfied smile with closed eyes, cheeks slightly flushed.
personas.P7_gadget: An anthropomorphic sea turtle detective who is a gadget maniac: a leather utility belt and chest harness loaded with tiny tools (tweezers, vials, a compass, a notebook), a headband with a flip-down loupe lens over one eye, fingerless gloves, brown deerstalker hat, an excited toothy grin, energetic pose.
personas.P8_mysterious: An anthropomorphic sea turtle detective who is mysterious and cool: brown deerstalker hat pulled very low so only one glowing golden eye is visible under the brim, a long dark green scarf wrapped around the neck and fluttering, the orange trench coat collar turned high, a faint enigmatic smile, dramatic shadow across the face, slim silhouette.
